articleTitle: Coulomb Damped Relaxation Oscillations in Semiconductor Quantum Dot Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A theoretical approach combining rate equations with Coulomb scattering rates in InAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers is presented. We find strong damping of relaxation oscillations, and show the crucial importance of Coulomb interaction for this characteristic

articleTitle: Active Mode-Locking of Quantum Dot Fabry-Perot Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Monolithic and mono-section InAs/InP quantum dot Fabry-Perot laser diodes are fabricated and characterized in an actively mode-locked mode for ultra-stable clock signal generation. Electrical line-width as narrow as the 10 Hz detection resolution is obtained

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Laser using Microring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A widely tunable laser is demonstrated that employs two microring resonators with FSRs of 600 and 700 GHZ and ring radii of 5.9 and 8.9 μm respectively. The device was fabricated monolithically using the InGaAsP-InP material system. The device exhibited a wide tuning range of 30 nm

articleTitle: InP-based VCSELs with Buried Tunnel Junction for Optical Communication and Sensing in the 1.3-2.3 μm Wavelength Range
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this paper, we present recent progress on high-performance InP-based long-wavelength VCSELs such as 1.3 or 1.55 μm incorporating a buried tunnel junction (BTJ) for applications in optical communication and sensing

articleTitle: Mode-Hop-Free and Electrically Wavelength-Tunable Laser Array with 39.5 nm Tuning Range using Tunable Distributed Amplification DFB Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: An electrically wavelength-tunable laser array with tunable distributed amplification (TDA) DFB structure has been developed for the first time. A tuning range of 39.5 nm has been achieved by monolithic array of 8-channel mode-hop-free lasers

articleTitle: 20 Gb/s 85 °C Error Free Operation of VCSEL based on Submonolayer Deposition of Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: 980 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser based on sub-monolayer growth of quantum dots show for 20 Gb/s clearly open eyes and error free operation with bit error rates better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12 </sup> at 25 and 85°C

articleTitle: Single-Chip 40Gb/s Widely-Tunable Transceivers with Integrated SG-DBR Laser, QW EAM, UTC Photodiode, and Low Confinement SOA
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present the first single-chip, widely-tunable 40 Gb/s transceivers. The devices integrate sampled grating DBR lasers with electroabsorption modulators, low optical confinement semiconductor optical amplifiers, and uni-traveling carrier photodiodes

articleTitle: 1.55-μm -Wavelength AlGaInAs Multiple-Quantum-Well Semi-Insulating Buried-Heterostructure Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: 1.55-μm-wavelength AlGaInAs semi-insulating buried-heterostructure (SI-BH) lasers were investigated. AlGaInAs λ/4-phase-shift DFB SI-BH lasers with good high temperature characteristics as well as stable single-mode oscillation were fabricated for the first time

articleTitle: NEMS Tunable VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present a novel electrostatic actuated nano-electromechanical (NEMS) tunable surface emitting lasers utilizing a movable single-layer large-index-contrast subwavelength grating. Single mode emission and continuous tuning were obtained at room temperature under CW operation

articleTitle: High Power, Very Low Noise, C.W. Operation of 1.32μm Quantum-Dot Fabry-Perot Laser Diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: 1.32 mum InAs quantum dot narrow ridge lasers have reached a record single spatial mode optical power of 130 mW/facet under CW operation. Furthermore we demonstrate a very low relative intensity noise of -159 dB/Hz plusmn2 dB/Hz in the 0.1-10 GHz range

articleTitle: Novel Surface Emitting Laser using High-Contrast Subwavelength Grating
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present a new class of surface emitting lasers utilizing a single-layer high-index-contrast subwavelength grating, instead of conventional DBR. Single polarization mode emission with low threshold current and 1 mW output power was obtained at 850 nm wavelength

articleTitle: Modulation Efficiency Enhancement of 1.55-μm Injection-Locked VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this paper, we report a systematic study on modulation properties of a VCSEL under ultrahigh injection-locking condition as a function of wavelength detuning (Deltalambda=lambda<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">master </sub>-lambda<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">slave</sub>). Experimental results are explained using a new VCSEL amplifier model incorporated into the established injection-locking laser rate equations

articleTitle: Semi-Cooled Operation (TLD=50?C) of 10.7-Gbit/s 1.55-μm Electro-Absorption Modulator Integrated DFB Laser for 80 km Transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We successfully demonstrated 10.7-Gbit/s operation of 1.55-μm EA/DFB lasers for 80 km transmission at 50°C for the first time. As a result, a clearly opened eye, 1.9 dB power penalty were obtained

articleTitle: Over 100-mW Output Power Operation of VOA Integrated Full C-Band External Cavity Wavelength Tunable Laser Utilizing High-Refractive-Index Gap Mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We have developed an ECTL based on a gain chip with monolithically integrated VOA and gap mirror. Low power consumption and high output power are demonstrated by optimizing VOA and using gap-filling technique

articleTitle: First Monolithic Integration of a Waveguide Optical Isolator with a Distributed Feedback Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrate a waveguide-optical-isolator-monolithically-integrated distributed-feedback laser diode with 1543.8 nm single mode emission and 4 dB optical isolation based on the nonreciprocal loss in the semiconductor optical amplifier waveguide with Fe thin film

articleTitle: High-Index-Contrast Oxide-Confined GaAsP/InGaAsN Multi-Quantum-Well Ridge Waveguide Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A modified wet thermal process is used to oxidize both GaAs waveguide and GaAsP/InGaAsN MQW layers of deeply-etched ridge waveguide lasers, providing up to a 2.3 times threshold reduction and strong index-guiding for kink-free operation

articleTitle: Low Thermal Resistance, Low Current Density, High-Speed 980 and 850nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Copper plated, vertical cavity surface emitting lasers fabricated from AlGaAs structures, with thermal resistance up to 50% less than previously published values exhibit increased power, modulation current efficiency factor (MCEF), and maximum modulation bandwidth including 18 GHz at 8 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>

articleTitle: Uncooled Lasers for Metropolitan Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: The recent progress and key issues of uncooled 1310/1550 nm diode lasers for the application to MAN are reviewed, from the viewpoint of low power consumption and small footprint of 10 Gbs 300-pin and X-series optical transceivers

articleTitle: High-Power (40mW) Full C-band Wavelength Tunable DFB Laser Array Integrated with Funnel Combiner
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A wavelength tunable DFB laser array integrated with a wavelength-independent funnel combiner is fabricated. The laser module covers the full C-band wavelength range (~38 nm), and a high fiber output power of 40 mW (16 dBm) is obtained with a stable single mode

articleTitle: 2.1-μm Wavelength InGaAs MQW DFB Lasers Grown by MOVPE using Sb Surfactant
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Emission wavelengths longer than 2.1 mum and CW output power higher than 8 mW at 25degC were achieved in strained InGaAs MQW DFB lasers grown by MOVPE using an Sb surfactant

articleTitle: Metal Nano-aperture VCSEL for Near-field Optics and Polarization Control
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of sub-100 nm optical near-field from metal nano-aperture VCSELs with strong plasmonic enhancement. The power density reaches at 0.8 MW/cm. Also, the rectangular aperture array allows us to control the polarization of top emitting VCSELs

articleTitle: 40 GHz Bandwidth and 64 GHz Resonance Frequency in Injection-Locked 1.55 um VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Injection locking is shown to greatly enhance the resonance frequency of 1.55mum VCSELs, from ~10 GHz to over 60 GHz, under ultra-high injection locking conditions. Additionally, a 3-dB bandwidth of over 40 GHz was attained, a record broad-band performance for directly modulated VCSELs

articleTitle: Tunable Optical Delay and Nonlinear Phase Shift using 1.55 μm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present the tunable optical delay and nonlinear phase-shift using reverse-biased 1.55 mum VCSEL. The reduction of recovery time in saturable absorber with increasing reverse bias would enable to control the phase of high speed optical signals

articleTitle: Short-Cavity 980 nm DBR Lasers with Quantum Well Intermixed Integrated High-Speed EA Modulators
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Short-cavity, 980 nm DBR lasers with integrated EAMs were designed and fabricated using a quantum well intermixing processing platform in the InGaAs/GaAs/AlGaAs material system. RF bandwidths of 16 GHz were achieved and open eyes at 10 Gb/s were observed with >7dB dynamic extinction

articleTitle: Electron Density Dynamics, Frequency Shift and Secondary Locking Region in an Optically Injected DFB Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: The mutual dynamics of electron density and frequency pulling in optically injected semiconductor lasers is theoretically and experimentally investigated and correlated with a new secondary locking region when under optical injection from two master lasers

articleTitle: 1.3 μm-Band Laser with a High Characteristic Temperature (T0=130 K) on an InGaAs Ternary Substrate Grown by the Traveling Liquidus-Zone Method
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We have developed high-performance 1.3 μm-band laser diodes on an InGaAs ternary substrate with a low indium content (In: 0.1) grown by a novel bulk crystal growth technique (TLZ method). This laser operates at a long wavelength of 1.28 μm and at temperatures up to 195degC by using a highly strained InGaAs quantum well. The characteristic temperatures are 130 K from 25 to 95°C and 95 K from 95 to 155°C

articleTitle: Suppression of Thermal Wavelength Drift in SSG-DBR Laser with Thermal Drift Compensation Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Thermal wavelength drift in an SSG-DBR laser is suppressed by introducing thermal drift compensation waveguide to DBR laser. Injecting a compensatory current into the thermal drift compensation waveguide reduces the wavelength drift from 1 GHz to around 0.1 GHz

articleTitle: Single Mode 1.28 μm InGaAs VCSELs using an Inverted Surface Relief
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: High performance 1.28 mum InGaAs single mode VCSELs have been fabricated using an inverted surface relief to relax critical fabrication tolerances. Higher order mode suppression >30 dB and 10 Gbps modulation are demonstrated up to 85°C

articleTitle: 1-Step OMVPE Grown Strongly Index-Coupled Membrane DFB Laser with Surface Corrugation Grating Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Strongly index-coupled GaInAsP/InP membrane DFB laser, consisting of a flat single-quantum-well active region, was realized by adopting a surface corrugation structure. A threshold pump power as low as 1.1 mW was achieved under RT-CW condition for the stripe width of 2.0 μm and the cavity length of 60 mum. The index-coupling coefficient was estimated to be 3,200 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> for the surface corrugation depth of 50 nm

articleTitle: Polarization-Independent, All-Optical Clock Extraction in a Mode-Locked Laser Diode with Polarization-Diversity Configuration
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Polarization-independent operation of all-optical clock extraction in a mode-locked laser diode was achieved at 40 Gbit/s using polarization diversity configuration. Polarization dependence of timing jitter was reduced to less than 0.1 ps

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Quantum Cascade Lasers with Improved Threshold Characteristics Operating up to Room Temperature
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We fabricated two-dimensional photonic crystal GaAs/AlGaAs quantum cascade lasers operating at room temperature. Compared to reference devices with cleaved facets, the high reflectivity photonic crystal mirrors lead to a ~34% reduction of the threshold currents

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Twin-Guide Laser Diodes with Large Continuous Tuning Range
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Widely tunable twin-guide laser diodes providing an SMSR and an output power above 35 dB and 10 mW, respectively, over a 40 nm tuning range are presented. Continuous tuning ranges as large as 8.2 nm are achieved

articleTitle: High Power Ultraviolet VECSEL through Intra-Cavity Frequency-Doubling in BBO
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Intra-cavity frequency-doubling in a beta-barium borate crystal has generated a total of 120 mW continuous-wave output power at 338 nm from a vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser based on the AlGaInP material system. The wavelength was tuned over 5 nm

articleTitle: 3 W - Broad Area Lasers and 12 W - Bars with Conversion Efficiencies up to 40% at 650 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: High power broad area lasers and bars for the wavelength 650 nm diode lasers with an output power of 3 W and a conversion efficiency of 40% at 15°C are presented. 5 mm wide laser bars reach 12 W output power

articleTitle: Gain without Inversion: An Approach for THz Quantum Cascade Laser?
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Using a microscopic theory based on the Maxwell-semiconductor Bloch equations, we investigate the possibilities of optically driven QCLs. We show that in a four level cascaded-emission scheme, quantum coherence effects can yield gain without inversion

articleTitle: High-Performance Small-Radius Half-Racetrack-Ring-Resonator InAlGaAs Quantum Well Laser Diodes Fabricated via Non-Selective Wet Oxidation
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Utilizing the high index contrast of a deep-etched, non-selectively oxidized AlGaAs/InAlGaAs GRINSCH heterostructure, half-racetrack-ring resonator lasers with peak output powers of 239 mW for a r=25 μm bend radius, and 40 mW for r=8 μm, are demonstrated

articleTitle: GaInNAs DFB Laser with Buried GaAs Grating
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We for the first time fabricated a GaInNAs DFB laser having a buried GaAs grating in the center current injection region. A successful DFB laser oscillation with the threshold current of 34 mA was obtained

articleTitle: Electrically Injected InGaAsP Microdisk Lasers Heterogeneously Integrated on a Si-Wafer
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We report on electrically pumped lasing in microdisk cavities etched in a thin InP-based membrane directly bonded on top of a silicon wafer. The microdisks were planarized by means of a benzocyclobutene (BCB) layer, into which contact windows were etched to perform current injection. The top metal contact is placed only in the centre of the disk, whereas the bottom contacting is done by means of a thin lateral InP contacting layer. In order to avoid large optical absorption in p-type contact layers, a tunnel junction was used in combination with two n-type contacts. Lasing was observed in pulsed regime at room temperature with current thresholds in the range 0.55-1.1 mA, for microdisks with a diameter in the range 6-9 mum

articleTitle: High-Temperature, Low-Threshold Injectorless Quantum-Cascade Lasers, Emitting at α ≈ 6.8 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present a five-level quantum-cascade laser design without injector miniband, showing small threshold current densities (0.15 kA/cm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 77 K and 1.65 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 300 K) and a maximum operating temperature of 420 K

articleTitle: High-Performance GaInNAs-TQW Edge Emitting Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: It was experimentally demonstrated that a record-low threshold current of 4.3 mA was achieved in long-wavelength, 1.29 μm, GaInNAs-TQW RWG lasers. Moreover, high characteristic temperature of 115 K was attained

articleTitle: Analysis of very low threshold current density GaInNAs laser at low temperature
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: GaInNAs lasers grown on GaAs substrates are very attractive for the application of uncooled operation with high performance at 1.3 mum region. However, fundamental material and device properties which are important for device design are still not fully understood. In this paper, we investigated temperature dependence of laser and light emitting diode (LED) characteristics for this purpose. We found that the threshold current density (Jth) of GalnNAs laser was considerably lower than that of GaInAs laser at low temperature, although it is much higher at room temperature

articleTitle: High-Brightness from an Unstable Resonator Mid-IR Semiconductor Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We describe high-brightness, broad-area mid-IR semiconductor lasers. These devices were fabricated in our laboratory using a commercial solid-source MBE system, configured specifically for antimonide alloy deposition. The laser structures incorporated fourteen type-II quantum wells embedded in thick waveguide/absorber regions composed of In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-y </sub>. Each type-II well is comprised of a ~24 Aring thick In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4 </sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>Sb hole bearing layer, which is sandwiched in between two coupled InAs electron wells; as we vary the InAs thickness from 3 to 30 Aring we tune the laser from 2.5 μm to 9.5 μm

articleTitle: New Double-Bragg DBR Laser for C-band Tuning with only One Bragg Current Control
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present a new tunable laser with double Bragg sections, providing 28 nm tuning range with only one coarse tuning current as in a DBR laser, and with large tolerances on technology and control currents

articleTitle: Monte Carlo Simulation of AlGaAs/GaAs QCLs Including Both ? and X Valley Transport
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Comprehensive Monte Carlo simulation of AlGaAs/GaAs QCLs reveals two carrier-loss mechanisms: Gamma states coupling to the same-stage X states and to the next-stage X states. Excellent agreement with experiment is achieved

articleTitle: 9 W Output Power from a 808 nm Tapered Diode Laser in Pulse Mode Operation with Nearly Diffraction-Limited Beam Quality
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: High-power 808 nm tapered diode lasers are fabricated based on a SLOC structure with very small divergence of 18deg. 14 W overall output power with 9 W of nearly diffraction-limited beam quality are presented

articleTitle: Polarization Control of VCSEL Array by Metal Nanoholes at Rectangular Lattice Utilizing Surface Plasmon Resonance
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We report on polarization control of 850 nm 2times2 VCSEL array by metal nanoholes at rectangular lattice utilizing surface plasmon (SP) resonance. The polarization angle can be controlled to any specified directions by the direction of the lattice, of which the pitch meets the SP resonant condition. This VCSEL array is applicable to future polarization multiplexed optical communication

articleTitle: Small signal moduation of dual oxide cavity composite resonator vertical cavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We report small signal modulation greater than 10 GHz for the first time from composite-resonator vertical-cavity laser (CRVCL) devices with reduced capacitance using metal contacts on polymer layers, which has been successfully employed in conventional VCSELs. We find that the dynamics of the laser are determined by the total photon density rather than the individual values of current. These modulation results, combined with high slope efficiency, may enable new VCSEL-based optical link applications for the CRVCL

articleTitle: Analysis of the Major Loss Processes in Mid-Infrared Type-II fiWfl Diode Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: The results from high-pressure and low-temperature measurements on mid-infrared type-II W-structure lasers suggest that Auger recombination is the major loss process that prevents their continuous-wave operation at room temperature

articleTitle: High-Power and Broad-Band Quantum Dot SLDs for Optical Coherence Tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Quantum dot superluminescent diodes exhibiting 2.5 mW and 125 nm FWHM at 1.27 μm are demonstrated and techniques for realization of broad-band flat-topped emission are discussed. Record high CW power of 42 mW is also demonstrated for narrow-band devices

articleTitle: Tunable Optical Delay using Quantum Dot VCSEL by Polarization Control
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: This study experimentally demonstrates the tunable optical delay using a 1.3 μm quantum dot VCSEL. Tunable optical delays of 42 ps for 10 GHz are achieved by varying the bias current and the signal polarization

articleTitle: A Highly Stable Evanescently-Coupled Fiber Semiconductor Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A hybrid fiber-semiconductor laser employing evanescent coupling between a novel photonic band-gap waveguide and a single-mode fiber is presented. High spectral purity, easy packaging, and low temperature dependence are notable features of these systems

articleTitle: Simultaneous Oscillation of Two-Colour Discrete Mode Fabry-Perot Laser Diodes using Non-Periodic Index Patterns
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present two-colour Fabry-Perot lasers obtained using non-periodic effective index patterns. The devices oscillate simultaneously on two Fabry-Perot modes and are attractive for THz generation

articleTitle: Efficient Unidirectional Wavelength-Scale Photonic Crystal Light Emitters
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We have shown that the unidirectional photonic crystal emitter whose > 80% energy is concentrated within a small divergence angle of plusmn30deg can be achieved by placing a Bragg mirror and tuning the defect structure

articleTitle: High-Power Single Mode InGaAs Sub-Monolayer Quantum-Dot Photonic-Crystal VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: An InGaAs sub-monolayer (SML) quantum dot photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (QD PhC-VCSEL) for fiber-optic applications is first demonstrated. Single fundamental mode CW output power of 3.8 mW has been achieved in the 990 nm range, with a threshold current of 1 mA. SMSR larger than 35 dB has been observed over entire operation range

articleTitle: Fast Spontaneous Emission Decay in Photonic Crystal Point-Shift Nanolaser with Ultimate-Small Modal Volume
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrated the Purcell effect in the point-shift photonic crystal nanolaser with an ultrasmall modal volume of 2.1(lambda/2n) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. A 28-fold faster spontaneous emission decay was observed in the time-resolved measurement

articleTitle: Maximising the Gain and Minimising the Non-Radiative Recombination in 1.3μm Quantum Dot Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We assess three methods to increase the gain in quantum-dot-lasers based on increasing the number of dots states and increasing the population of the available states by reducing the effect of the wetting layer

articleTitle: All-Optical 10-Gbps Packet Switching by DBR-MMI-BLD All-Optical Flip-Flop
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: All-optical packet switching has been demonstrated using DBR-MMI-BLD all-optical flip-flops. Single-mode lasing flip-flop output switched 10-Gbps optical packets through cross-phase modulation in all-optical MZI switches. Error free operation has been achieved with 1.8-dB power penalty

articleTitle: Intrinsic Limitations of p-doped and Undoped 1.3 μm InAs/GaAs Quantum Dot Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: The temperature dependencies of the recombination and gain processes reveal intrinsic limitations on the performances of quantum dot lasers. Controlling the transport of the carriers using the inhomogeneous broadening makes temperature stable threshold current possible

articleTitle: Extremely Increasing the Mode-Locking Range of Hybrid Soliton Pulse Source
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: It is shown that proper mode-locking range where transform-limited pulses are generated is increased up to 1.3 GHz by using linearly chirped raised-cosine flat top apodized FBG instead of linearly chirped Gaussian podized FBG giving a mode-locking range of 850 MHz

articleTitle: Random Population and Localised Recombination in Quantum Dot Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Calculations show that total recombination rates in dots have similar dependencies on total carrier density due to carrier localisation, consequently the total Auger rate is suppressed relative to radiative recombination at high carrier populations

articleTitle: A Ring Cavity Raman Silicon Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Silicon photonics has made rapid progress in recent years achieving several key breakthroughs. In particular, chip-scale silicon lasers and amplifiers based on stimulated Raman scattering have been successfully demonstrated in continuous wave operation

articleTitle: Quantum Dot Modelocked and Broad-Band Lasers for Optical Interconnect Solutions
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Quantum-dot lasers demonstrate broadband (20 nm) emission spectra and high spectral power densities (>20 mW/nm). Monolithic mode-locked InAs/InGaAs quantum-dot lasers operate at 5 GHz with a peak power of 1.7 W and a pulse width of 3.2 ps

articleTitle: Auger Recombination is NOT Necessary to Explain the Temperature Dependence of Threshold in p-doped Quantum Dot Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We measure the temperature dependence of the components of threshold current of 1300 nm undoped and p-doped quantum-dot-lasers and show that the temperature dependence of gain is the largest factor in producing the observed negative T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>

articleTitle: Facet Passivation of GaInAsP/InP Laser Diodes by Aluminum Ultrathin Layer Insertion
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrated that facet degradation is successfully suppressed by inserting aluminum ultra-thin layer between semiconductor and dielectric coating films. We also clarified that aluminum layer suppress lack of phosphorus and increase in surface recombination

articleTitle: Enhancement of Optical Gain in Sb-based MIR Diode Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this work we present a successful approach to enhance the gain characteristics of In(Al)GaAsSb MIR diode lasers by using In-rich highly-strained quaternary QW materials. Our lasers demonstrate three times increase in the differential gain with halved threshold current. Calculations show that observed gain enhancement is caused by improvement of hole confinement in highly strained QWs

articleTitle: Lasing at ~1.3 μm from InAs Quantum Dots with GaInNAs Embedding Layers Grown by Metalorganic Chemical Vapor Deposition
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: Self-assembled InAs quantum dot (QD) lasers emitting at 1.29 μm on GaAs substrates grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) were achieved by using GaInNAs embedding layers. This emission wavelength is the longest wavelength ever reported for QD lasers grown by MOCVD

articleTitle: Thermoelectric Cooled Mid-IR Interband Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this paper, we will report our recent progress in developing thermoelectric (TE) cooled mid-IR IC Fabry-Perot (FP) and distributed feedback (DFB) lasers which can operate in CW mode at temperatures up to 264 and 255 K, respectively

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated, Sampled Grating DBR Laser Transmitter with an Asymmetric Quantum Well Electroabsorption Modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present the first widely-tunable transmitter that employs intra-step quantum wells for intensity modulation. Fiber coupled output power is >2 dBm with tuning range >40 nm. EAMs show modulation depths >20 dB, slope efficiency >7 dB/V, and 10 bandwidth

articleTitle: InGaNAs Quantum Dot Lasers at 1.36 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrate a pseudomorphic InGaNAs quantum dot laser with laser emission wavelength 1.36 mum grown by molecular beam epitaxy. In comparison with a nitrogen-free reference QD laser a redshift of 100 nm is observed

articleTitle: 25W 915nm Lasers with Window Structure Fabricated by Impurity Free Vacancy Disordering (IFVD)
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We have demonstrated high performance broad area single emitter lasers with window structure fabricated by newly developed IFVD technique. A very high output power of 25 W was obtained in 100 μm wide lasers without facet degradation

articleTitle: 10 Gbps Modulation of 1.3 μm GaInNAs Lasers up to 110°C
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrate uncooled 10 Gbps operation of 1.3 μm ridge waveguide GaInNAs lasers with a double quantum well active region up to 110°C. The low temperature sensitivity enables the use of a constant modulation voltage

articleTitle: Polarization Control of 1.2 μm Single-mode VCSELs using Photonic Crystal Polarizer
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel method for polarization control of 1.2 mum band single-mode InGaAs VCSELs with hybrid integration of an auto-cloned photonic crystal polarizer, which shows stable polarization operations without penalties in laser performances

articleTitle: Compact High Peak Power MOPA Assembly based on Grating Coupled Laser Diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: A hybrid MOPA was assembled by stacking laser diodes incorporating grating couplers. Applying subnanosecond driving pulses for both MO and flared PA, optical pulses with 130 W peak power and 98 psec pulsewidth were achieved

articleTitle: Uniform and High-Power Characteristics of AlGaInP-based Laser Diodes by 4-inch Wafer Process Technology for DVD-R/RW/RAM
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the high-power (over 400 mW) at 75 degC single-lateral-mode operation of a 650-nm band LD, and we present the excellent uniformity of LD characteristics in 4-inch wafer. In summary, we have successfully fabricated high-power and single-lateral-mode 650-nm band AlGaInP LDs by using the 4-inch wafer process technology for the first time. The results confer the promising way to realize the high-speed (over 8times) dual layer recordable DVD systems

articleTitle: InP-based Quantum Cascade Distributed Feedback Lasers with Deeply Etched Lateral Gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We report device results and techniques for fabricating gratings for InP-based quantum cascade (DFB) lasers, grown by MOVPE. Deeply etched lateral gratings are achieved by the development of a novel two-stage ICP etch process

articleTitle: Characteristics of 1.3-μm Quantum Dots Laser with a High Density and a High Uniformity QD
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this paper, we report the characteristics of a high density QD laser. In this report, we have realized high density (7.2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> cm and high uniformity (25 meV) QD. Also, we have demonstrated a large modal gain of 54 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at a grand state emission of beyond 1.3 μm. It is concluded that the proposed high density and high uniformity InGaAs QD fabrication method using GC-SRL and As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> source becomes a break through technique of QD laser

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Photonic Crystals Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrate tunable semiconductor lasers based on three coupled photonic crystal cavities, that allows up to 18 nm tuning range with a side-mode suppression ratio greater than 3.5 dB, in two different wavelength ranges

articleTitle: Investigations of the Linewidth of Intersubband Quantum Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical investigations of the linewidth of quantum cascade lasers. We find linewidths in the kilohertz range depending on the injection current due to a non-constant linewidth enhancement factor

articleTitle: Diffraction Limited Single Mode Emission of Photonic Crystal Distributed Feedback Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We present photonic crystal distributed feedback lasers fabricated from InGaAs/GaAs/AlGaAs layers, where spectral and spatial mode selection is provided by a lattice of air holes. The emission is diffraction limited and single mode with 50 dB sidemode suppression ratio

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optical Effects in InxGa(1-x)As Quantum Systems for Saturable Absorbers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this study we present measurements of the intrinsic properties of three quantum systems: bound and excitonic QWs states, and QDs. We start by measuring the external properties of two saturable absorbers, one with QWs and the other with QDs. By fitting this measured external data, we then calculate the intrinsic properties of each of the three quantum systems and compare their merits as saturable absorbing materials

articleTitle: Beam-Steering in Photonic Crystal Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser Arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: In this paper, the control of the relative phase between elements of a coherent photonic crystal VCSEL array using independent current injection, which leads to electronic beam steering, is demonstrated. For controlled beam steering, we electrically isolate the two PhC defects by etching a thin trench by FIBE (focused ion beam etching). It is concluded that more than 3deg angular shift can be controllably obtained, demonstrating electronic beam-steering

articleTitle: Recent Progress in Long Wavelength Quantum Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: The quantum cascade lasers technology has witnessed important progress in the last few years, with the demonstration of single frequency continuous wave operation above room temperature. Terahertz quantum cascade lasers have also shown great performance improvements with very long wavelength and two color operation

articleTitle: Low Driving-Voltage 40-Gbit/s Electroabsorption Modulator Integrated DFB Laser Module with Low Chirp Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: We demonstrated successful 3-km transmission using a 40-Gbit/s EA-DFB laser module with driving voltage as low as 2 V. The installed EA-DFB chip has an optimized device structure which is operatable under low chirp condition

articleTitle: Quantum Dot Based Phase Modulator at 1300 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: InAs based quantum-dot lasers have demonstrated giant phase-amplitude couplings. Here we show in an optical amplifier an effective decoupling of the differential index from the differential gain leading to a pure phase modulator

articleTitle: Screening of Piezoelectric Fields in InGaN Quantum Well Laser Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 IEEE 20th International Semiconductor Laser Conference, 2006. Conference Digest.
abstract: By modelling time resolved emission spectra of 3 and 4 nm In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.07</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.93</sub>N quantum wells we show that injected carriers reduce the internal field to only 70% of its unscreened value at typical laser thresholds
